world.h: Iran warns Gulf states against US attack support as it steps up strikes
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran warns Gulf states against US attack support as it steps up strikes

world.h: Saudi coalition intercepts missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh
world.b: The coalition said it destroyed two ballistic missiles and two suspected Houthi drones; Saudi authorities say at least 26 people have been killed in such attacks since September 23.
world.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts suspected Houthi missiles and drones

world.h: Car blast near Damascus kills father and child
world.b: Syria's Internal Security Forces opened an investigation into the explosion in Jaramana, home to a large Druze community.

world.h: Netanyahu renews call for unity government with Eisenkot
world.b: Neither bloc won a majority in the Oct. 27 election; Eisenkot dismissed the appeal as a ploy, saying Netanyahu knows he lost.
world.title: Netanyahu says only a unity government can guarantee Israel’s security

world.h: Israeli strike targets senior Hamas commander in Khan Younis
world.b: Israel's military said it targeted a senior Hamas commander in a drone strike Saturday that hit a tent sheltering displaced people. Gaza's health ministry says Israeli attacks killed 16 people in 48 hours.
world.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza

world.h: Trump's shifting Iran rhetoric leaves Middle East in limbo
world.b: Since the midterms, the president has backed away from both further strikes and further talks on ending the 8-month-old war.
world.title: With shifting Iran rhetoric following U.S. elections, Trump leaves Middle East in limbo about path ahead

world.h: Zelenskyy warns US-floated security framework could help Putin
world.b: Ukraine's president said a new European security framework raised by the US could let Moscow weaken NATO and reshape borders.
world.title: Zelenskyy says a new European security framework floated by U.S. could benefit Putin

world.h: Kushner aims to broker Europe-Russia talks on Ukraine
world.b: The US envoy said both sides know compromises will be needed, after Abu Dhabi talks produced a prisoner swap but no breakthrough.

world.h: EU calls for immediate humanitarian access to Gaza
world.b: The bloc urged access for aid groups after devastating flooding this week, as an Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in Jabaliya on Saturday.

world.h: Zelenskyy says US raised NATO-for-Donbas idea
world.b: Ukraine's president said US negotiators asked at Abu Dhabi talks whether Kyiv would pull troops from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership. He said no concrete offer exists and Ukraine won't withdraw.

world.h: UN says 25 seafarers killed around Hormuz since war began
world.b: The UN tracked 136 security incidents involving vessels in the region since March, as Iran reported three tankers hit mines Saturday.

world.h: ICC halts probe into alleged crimes by US troops in Afghanistan
world.b: Judges cited significant limits on the prosecution's ability to gather evidence; the prosecutor's office says it has appealed.

world.h: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit
world.b: The leaders will meet next week on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with nuclear stockpiles on the agenda nine months after New START lapsed.

national.h: Judge pauses Trump's plan to redevelop DC public golf course
national.b: A federal judge ordered a two-week delay on work at East Potomac Golf Links, which was due to close Sunday for 15 months.
national.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment

national.h: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade over anti-DEI law
national.b: Delray Beach says the new state law, which takes effect Jan. 1, bars it from putting on the nearly 60-year-old celebration. It will also drop Pride sponsorship.
national.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law

national.b: Researchers told KFF Health News that the Pan American Health Organization concluded measles has reestablished regular transmission in the US, a quarter century after elimination.
national.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say

national.h: New Orleans port sues to seize tanker that hit cruise boat
national.b: All 197 people aboard the American Heritage survived Friday's crash; a judge gave federal officials control of the tanker for now.
national.title: New Orleans port sues to get control of tanker that crashed into cruise ship on Mississippi River

national.h: States get until July to drop Medicaid enrollees over work rules
national.b: The Trump administration told states they won't have to cut anyone off for failing the work requirement until July 1, though it still takes effect Jan. 1.

national.h: Flu season off to a very early start
national.b: The CDC says seven states reported high flu activity last week, up from two, with Louisiana hit hardest so far.
national.title: The U.S. flu season is off to a very early start. It's hitting the South and West now

national.h: Duffy ties ground stop to contractor's line upgrade
national.b: The transportation secretary said Friday's nationwide halt began when contractor L3Harris hit an error while swapping copper for fiber at a remote FAA site. The FAA is still investigating the exact cause.
national.title: FAA blames Friday's ground stop on 'equipment issue' during telecoms network upgrade

national.h: US measles deaths reach 10 this year
national.b: Two more deaths were reported as confirmed cases topped 5,400, more than double last year's total.

politics.h: NYC socialists urge Ocasio-Cortez to run for president
politics.b: The city's DSA chapter voted 291 to 123 to encourage a 2028 bid, short of a formal endorsement.
politics.title: New York Democratic Socialists urge Ocasio-Cortez to run for US president

politics.h: Democrats find hope at post-midterms conference in Denver
politics.b: After winning virtually every contested race, party strategists at the What's Next conference say they can see the outlines of a post-Trump era.
politics.title: Democrats try out a strange new emotion at post-midterms What's Next conference: hope

politics.h: Alaska voters keep open primaries and ranked-choice voting
politics.b: It's the second time in two years voters rejected a repeal of the system, which Trump opposes.
politics.title: Alaska voters reject ballot measure seeking to repeal open primaries and ranked voting system

politics.h: Alaska elects first Democratic governor since 1998
politics.b: Former state lawmaker Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins defeated three Republicans, including one endorsed by President Trump, as part of the party's midterm wave in state governments.

international.h: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift
international.b: Congo has threatened to leave the French-speaking group if Rwanda's Louise Mushikiwabo wins a third term as secretary-general on Monday.
international.title: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift

international.h: Jordan sentences three to death over church attack
international.b: A state security court convicted the men of the October gun attack on a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak that killed nine people.
international.title: Jordan sentences three men to death by hanging after deadly church attack

international.h: Iraq's PM fires nine officials over oil smuggling
international.b: Ali al-Zaidi dismissed security officers and a pipeline director after an investigation found illegal refineries in Jurf al-Nasr, a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.

international.h: Men rally in Bern against violence toward women
international.b: Hundreds of men gathered outside Switzerland's parliament to denounce misogyny and online 'manosphere' influence.

international.h: South Sudan delays first national elections to February
international.b: The election commission moved the vote from December 22 to February 11 without giving a reason, the latest of several delays.

international.h: Philippine court orders arrest of jailed preacher wanted by US
international.b: The warrant for Quiboloy, whose extradition Washington requested in August, means the court must now hold hearings on whether to hand him over.

international.h: Nearly $20m in cash found hidden in Hungary's forests
international.b: Investigators searching in a corruption probe found money buried in forests and stashed in farm buildings, amid a case against former development minister Miklos Sesztak, who denies wrongdoing.

international.h: Germany grants spy agencies sweeping new powers
international.b: The reform lets the BND and BfV actively disrupt threats, such as deleting stolen data from an attacker's server, not just gather intelligence.

international.h: UK police open sex offence probe into David Walliams
international.b: The Metropolitan Police said it received allegations of non-recent serious sexual offences, separate from misconduct claims reported this week by ITV and The Guardian.

business.h: Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage
business.b: Outlook, Teams and Copilot were interrupted for hours, with outage reports from users in more than 70 countries and territories.

science.h: Starship caught by launch pad arms after orbital flight
science.b: SpaceX caught a Starship returning from space for the first time Saturday, 22 hours after a liftoff in which the booster exploded.
science.title: SpaceX’s Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first

sports.b: The Yellow Jackets snapped a four-game skid with a largely interim staff and held the Tigers to 228 yards.

sports.h: Ground stop forces NFL to reshuffle Week 10 officials
sports.b: Officials were reassigned to games within driving distance of home, with two referees working as umpires on Sunday.

sports.h: Jeremiah Smith becomes Big Ten's all-time receiving leader
sports.b: The Ohio State star passed Purdue's John Standeford, whose record stood for 23 years, with a 22-yard catch against Northwestern.

sports.h: UFC 334 brings two title fights to Madison Square Garden
sports.b: Ciryl Gane makes his first heavyweight title defense against Josh Hokit in Saturday night's main event.

sports.h: FAA ground stop leaves college football teams scrambling
sports.b: Programs preparing for road games had to look for alternate travel plans after the nationwide halt.

sports.h: Red Sox reportedly sign Jake Bauers for $58 million
sports.b: The NLCS MVP agreed to a four-year deal after hitting 26 homers for the champion Brewers, ESPN reports.

sports.h: Pochettino leaves USMNT for Manchester United
sports.b: He led the US to a Round of 16 finish at the 2026 World Cup, with three wins, the most by a USMNT coach at a World Cup.

local.h: Tech problems stall specialized high school test
local.b: The DOE will reschedule the SHSAT for students who couldn't finish after vendor Pearson reported technical issues; testing continues Nov. 15.
local.title: NYC's specialized high school test stalled by technical problems, DOE says

local.h: Brooklyn power plant expansion fuels data center fears
local.b: AlphaGen wants to expand two floating peaker plants near Sunset Park, prompting protests from environmentalists.
local.title: Expansion proposal for Brooklyn plants fuels data center fears

local.h: Hochul calls on Duffy to resign over FAA meltdown
local.b: The governor said the transportation secretary must resign or be removed after Friday's nationwide ground stop led to cancellations into Saturday.
local.title: Gov. Hochul calls on Duffy to resign after FAA meltdown grounds nation's flights

local.h: FAA meltdown strands Gov. Sherrill in Denver
local.b: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill was among the travelers stranded by Friday's nationwide ground stop while at a Democratic conference in Denver. She's now expected back Saturday morning.
local.title: FAA meltdown strands NJ Gov. Sherrill at Dem conference in Denver

localgood.h: Loew's Jersey Theatre reopens after $130M renovation
localgood.b: The nearly century-old Jersey City theater near Journal Square is welcoming the public back after five years closed, with two sold-out concerts this weekend.
localgood.title: 'A palace for the people': Historic, grand Loew's theater reopens in Jersey City
